replies.subject: Re: quota planning without the spreadsheet
replies.body: This is timely. We're rebuilding territories for FY27 and I'd like to see how you handle mid-year rebalancing. Do you have 30 minutes Thursday?

replies.subject: Automatic reply: quota planning without the spreadsheet
replies.body: I am out of the office until 14 September with limited access to email. For urgent matters please contact ops@northwindpay.com.

replies.subject: Re: enterprise motion

replies.body: We're mid-migration to Salesforce so nothing until that's done, probably January. Ping me then.

replies.subject: Out of office
replies.body: Thanks for your note. I'm travelling this week and will reply on my return on Monday.

replies.subject: Re: reply handling
replies.body: Yes, let's talk. Our SDR team spends half its day triaging inboxes. Send a few times for next week.
